summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K disclosing the issuance of US$800 million (plus US$100 million greenshoe) of 2.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. The notes have an initial conversion price of ~US$27.40 per share, a ~32.5% premium to the US$20.68 closing price on June 4, 2026. Proceeds (~US$772.7 million net) will fund a capped call transaction (~US$83 million) and general corporate purposes, including potential acquisitions. The notes are senior unsecured, redeemable after July 1, 2029 under certain conditions, and subject to fundamental change put. The conversion premium suggests an equity-linked capital raise, not a special-situation catalyst.
